common.underConstructionBody: This module ships in {phase}. The navigation is already wired so you can walk through it.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: We'll email you a sign-in link. No password to remember.
auth.linkSent: Done. Check {email} and open the link on this same device.
auth.sendFailed: Couldn't send the link. Try again in a moment.
auth.callbackFailed: That link didn't work or has expired. Request a new one.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.body: Your account isn't allowed into the admin panel. If you think that's a mistake, talk to the owner.

dashboard.title: Financial summary
dashboard.description: Sales, margin, cash by currency, and inventory at cost and at market.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: Cards, boxes, and lots, with allocated cost and market value.
inventory.emptyAll: No inventory yet. Start by registering a purchase.
inventory.results: {count, plural, =0 {no results} one {# piece} other {# pieces}}

totals.title: Inventory value
totals.hiddenCosts: {count, plural, one {# piece with no visible cost} other {# pieces with no visible cost}}
totals.consignedNote: It's in the vault but belongs to others: it doesn't add to your equity.
totals.consumedNote: Its cost already moved to the cards that came out. Not counted twice.
totals.notComputable: Can't be computed without every cost.

detail.notFound: That piece doesn't exist or was deleted.

blocked.STATUS_NOT_SELLABLE: Its status doesn't allow selling it.
blocked.NO_PHOTO: It needs at least one photo: a listing without a photo isn't a listing.
blocked.BELOW_CONSIGNOR_MIN: The price is below the minimum agreed with the consignor.
blocked.CONSIGNMENT_TERMS_UNKNOWN: This is a consigned card and your role can't see the agreement. Ask the owner.

photos.deleteConfirm: Remove this photo? The file is deleted too.

errors.TOO_LARGE: The image is too big, even after resizing.
errors.UPLOAD_FAILED: Couldn't upload the image. Try again.
errors.DELETE_FAILED: Couldn't delete the file, so the photo was left as it was.

break.title: Open break
break.intro: The box becomes «opened» and its cost is split among the cards that came out. The total doesn't change: it only changes hands.
break.revenueHelp: Break revenue of your own. It doesn't reduce the cards' cost.
break.weightedHelp: Hits carry more cost than filler. Without this, it's an even split.
break.costPending: Break opened. The cost split is pending for the owner.
break.noCost: This box has no recorded cost, so there's nothing to split.

errors.NOT_A_BOX: Only sealed boxes, packs, or lots can be opened.
errors.ALREADY_OPENED: That box was already opened or sold.
errors.MULTIPLE_UNITS: That row has more than one unit. Split it into rows of one first.
errors.NO_CHILDREN: A break with no cards isn't recorded.
errors.UNBALANCED: The split doesn't match the box cost.

labels.title: Labels
labels.hint: Each label carries the SKU and its QR code. Print on sticker sheets and cut along the guides.

bulk.done: {count, plural, one {# piece updated} other {# pieces updated}}
bulk.publishNote: Publishing is done piece by piece: each one has to meet its conditions.

sell.title: Sell
sell.description: Fast point of sale and store orders with payment verification.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.description: Auction lots, shared costs, and allocation by hammer price.
purchases.emptyHint: Register the first lot and the system splits the costs among the cards.
purchases.awaiting: {days, plural, one {# day undelivered} other {# days undelivered}}

wizard.title: Register purchase
wizard.draftRestored: Recovered the draft you left unfinished.
wizard.minimum: The minimum: type, category, and hammer. The rest can wait.
wizard.cardFeeTouched: You're setting it by hand. It won't recalculate.
wizard.localHelp: Courier and customs are paid in Bs. The original amount and the day's rate are stored.
wizard.allocationHelp: Each card carries its hammer plus its share of the shared costs. The sum is exactly the lot total.
wizard.certConflict: That cert is already in inventory
wizard.certDuplicateInForm: That cert is repeated in this same lot
wizard.alreadyExisted: That lot was already registered. Nothing was duplicated.

errors.NO_LINES: A lot with no cards isn't recorded.
errors.HAMMER_MISMATCH: The lot hammer doesn't match the sum of the cards.
errors.ALLOCATION_MISMATCH: The split doesn't match the lot total.
errors.DUPLICATE_REFERENCE: A lot with that platform and reference already exists.
errors.CERT_CONFLICT: Some card has a cert that's already in inventory.

detail.netHelp: Realized plus market of what's left, minus what the lot cost.
detail.noMarket: No piece in this lot has a valuation yet.
detail.someWithoutMarket: {count, plural, one {# piece not valued} other {# pieces not valued}}
detail.receivedOk: {count, plural, =0 {Lot marked as received.} one {Received. # piece moved to inventory.} other {Received. # pieces moved to inventory.}}

import.title: Importer
import.description: Upload the weekly spreadsheet and the system creates the lots, the items and the cost allocation.
import.reverted: {items, plural, one {# item was undone} other {# items were undone}}.
import.templateSaved: Template saved. Next week there is nothing to map.

upload.title: Upload the file
upload.hint: Excel and CSV. A title or blank rows on top are fine: the header row is found on its own.
upload.roundtrip: Download inventory to edit in Excel
upload.roundtripHint: Every row carries its SKU: re-uploading updates the item instead of creating a lot.
upload.sheetHint: The sheet must be shared by link (“Anyone with the link”). No access to your Google account is requested.

map.title: Check the mapping
map.hint: This is what each column was understood to be. Fix what you need and save it as a template: next week there will be nothing to map.
map.truncated: The file was larger than the cap and only the first 5,000 rows were read.
map.saveAs: Save this mapping as a template
map.templateMissing: The template expected columns this file does not have: {headers}. Check the mapping before continuing.

validate.ambiguous: Some values can be read two ways, and guessing wrong would change the amounts. Choose how they are read.

report.title: Done
report.hint: The items are in inventory with their cost allocated.

history.title: Recent imports
history.hint: A batch can be undone for {days} days, as long as none of its items has been sold, published or photographed.

errors.FORBIDDEN: Your role cannot upload files to the importer.
errors.NO_HEADER_ROW: No header row was found. Check that the table has at least three recognizable columns.
errors.UNREADABLE: The file could not be read.
errors.DUPLICATE_NAME: There is already a template with that name.
errors.SAVE_FAILED: The template could not be saved.
errors.NOT_A_SHEET: That link does not look like Google Sheets. Copy the address bar with the sheet open.
errors.NOT_SHARED: The sheet is not shared. In Google Sheets: Share → Anyone with the link → Viewer.
errors.NOT_FOUND: That sheet does not exist or was deleted.
errors.TOO_LARGE: The sheet is larger than 8 MB.
errors.TIMEOUT: Google did not answer in time. Try again.
errors.UNREACHABLE: The sheet could not be fetched.
errors.UPLOAD_FAILED: The sheet was fetched but could not be stored.
errors.VISION_DISABLED: Photo import needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the server.
errors.VISION_REFUSED: The model could not process that image.
errors.VISION_UNREADABLE: No card was recognized in the photo. Try more light or get closer.

photo.title: Import from a photo
photo.hint: The label gives the card data. Platform, date and lot costs are yours to type: no photo knows them.
photo.disabled: Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the server. The rest of the importer works the same.
photo.alwaysReviewed: Whatever is read goes through the preview before anything is created. Nothing enters inventory unseen.
photo.forbidden: Your role cannot upload photos to the importer.
photo.badImage: That image could not be prepared.
photo.uploadFailed: The photo could not be uploaded.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Balances by account and currency, movements, FX, and reconciliation.

receivables.title: Outstanding
receivables.description: Receivables and payables, with days overdue and reminders.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Profile, purchase history, wishlist, and segments.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Income statement, turnover, aging, and FX differential.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.description: Natural-language questions about inventory, sales, and finances.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Accounts, channel fees, consignment commission, and store details.

home.title: Collectible cards and sealed boxes
home.subtitle: Graded, raw, and sealed. Sports and TCG.
